info.title: Fenergo Nebula External Data Query
info.description:
**External Data Query API**:
External Data Query API allows to retrieve information of external data providers and their configuration.
**External Data Query API provides**:
  • The ability to get provider configuration.
  • The ability to get signed url for documents.
  • The ability to get imported data.
  • The ability to get mapping configuration of the provider.
  • The ability to get subscriptions for ongoing monitoring.
  • The ability to get external data search results.
